Attachment.description:
Something attached to a command in the composer: a file, a link, pasted text, or a document that was
already imported (uploads).

BarState.description: The bar tells the engine it opened or closed, for ducking (07 § Ducking).
BarState.title: BarState

Anchor.description: Where spoken text lives in the source. One of the three shapes in 04 (`playback.word`).
Anchor.title: Anchor

AssistantCard.description: Structured rows for the bar (09 § Rows, not screens).
AssistantCard.title: AssistantCard

AssistantTurn.description: A turn started (typed or spoken). Lets every client render the user row immediately.

BBox.description: PDF points, origin top-left of the page (y grows downward).

Capabilities.description:
What this build can do (GET /capabilities). Cloud features depend on the providers configured at
build time; nothing here can be changed from inside the app.

CapabilitiesChanged.description: What the build can do changed while running, e.g. the local speech model finished installing.

DocumentUpdated.description: The script for a document changed (rule saved, lexicon edit, regenerate) — reader refreshes.
DocumentUpdated.title: DocumentUpdated

RulesChanged.description: A rule file, the pronunciation list or the preferences changed (by voice, the editor or on disk).
RulesChanged.title: RulesChanged

SettingsChanged.description: settings.toml changed (by voice, the API or a hand edit): theme, language and shortcuts apply at once.
SettingsChanged.title: SettingsChanged

SpeechInput.title: SpeechInput

UiOpen.description:
The assistant asks the shell to show something: the rules editor (optionally on one file), the reader
for a document, or the bar.
